title: ClearSpeed Operate constitution
instruction: Numbered edition principles. Packet ddr.constitutionIds carries these ids; the critic must cite at least one on every partial/blocked turn.

principles.title: One filled primary in main
principles.rule: Operate main allows exactly one filled primary CTA; peers are outline/ghost.

principles.title: No peer worklists for one job
principles.rule: One triage job may not own two peer DataGrids/worklists in the fold.

principles.title: KPI encyclopedia off the decide path
principles.rule: Equal metric cards must not own the Monday decide path; collapse to ≤3 Summary lead chips. Park the rest after the focal worklist or on a secondary tab — never as accordion landfill under the lead.

principles.title: Stranger starts the job in ~3s
principles.rule: A stranger must name and start the primary Monday job in about three seconds.

principles.title: Page cite matches category
principles.rule: Page-scope cite must match the job category — no queue cite on settings, no dashboard-01 as triage lead.

principles.title: Fresh prove receipt required
principles.rule: Operate completion needs a fresh prove.mjs receipt linked to ddrId; compare alone is partial.

principles.title: Restructure before polish
principles.rule: No craft polish while structure is red (restructureHints / primaryTaskCheck).

principles.title: Decide queue: lead + attached overflow
principles.rule: Operate decide/worklist: Summary lead ≤3 chips with no accordion stack under it; exactly one filled decision primary with More attached in the same action cluster. Denoise park-in-details is not a redesign.
